[USER] User is looking for new ideas for meal prep.  
[USER] User is interested in protein sources that go well with quinoa and roasted vegetables.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Quinoa and roasted veggies are a fantastic combo!  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested protein sources include:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Grilled Chicken: Marinate chicken breast and grill.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Pan-Seared Salmon: Season with lemon juice, salt, and pepper.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Lentil or Mushroom Bolognese: Cook with onions, garlic, and tomatoes.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Roasted Turkey Breast: Season and roast in the oven.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. Tofu: Marinate and bake or pan-fry.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 6. Shrimp: Sauté with garlic, lemon, and herbs.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 7. Chickpeas: Add to quinoa and roasted veggies.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 8. Grilled Steak: Grill to liking and serve.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 9. Edamame: Boil or steam and season.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 10. Tempeh: Marinate and bake or pan-fry.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] These protein sources offer a variety of flavors and textures.  
[USER] User has had grilled chicken and turkey breast before.  
[USER] User has never tried lentil or mushroom bolognese.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Provided a simple recipe for Lentil Bolognese:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] **Servings:** 4-6  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] **Cooking Time:** 30-40 minutes  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] **Ingredients:** 1 cup dried green or brown lentils, 1 onion, 2 cloves garlic, 2 cups mixed mushrooms, 1 carrot, 1 celery stalk, 1 can crushed tomatoes, 1 tsp dried basil, 1 tsp dried oregano, salt and pepper, 1/4 cup red wine (optional).  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] **Instructions:** 1. Sauté aromatics, 2. Add mushrooms, 3. Add lentils and spices, 4. Add tomatoes and wine, 5. Simmer, 6. Season and serve.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Tips and variations for the recipe included.
